WHO_PAYS: Benchmark-constrained funds seeking low tracking error; suppliers bear ordinary equity, liquidity and event risk.
WHY_PERSIST: Mandated execution timing, small-stock depth and tracking-error constraints can create low-capacity inventory compensation; anticipatory arbitrage may eliminate it.
